## CHR-1257 — App UI refresh (design only)

Job from Christian (phone call 2026-11-26, 11:22 CET, passed on by Assi). Design only: no product code, no PR. Correction 11:38 CET (via Assi): the second reference is doop.design, not dupe.design.

**Problem:** the chrome (2.2.1) feels boxy, angular and dated. Screens, Context and Elements panels are fixed columns (264 + 252 + 280 px), so at 1440 px the open screen gets about 430 px. Update toast and variant tree overlay the canvas on top of that. Reference: `renders/current-2.2.1-screens.png`.

**Requirements:** (a) pleasing to the eye, (b) the screen gets the most space, (c) tools easy to reach, (d) hide what is not needed or never show it.

**Directions** (mockup `ui-refresh`, PNGs in `mockups/ui-refresh/renders/`):
1. `1-stitch` — floating, draggable, foldable cards on a dotted canvas; tools above the selected frame. Source: Google Stitch canvas redesign, blog.google (2026-03-18, 2026-05-19).
2. `2-doop` — Doop layout: three floating top groups with live agent status, tabbed left panel, vertical tool rail, frames with agent cursor and write state, tabbed right panel with activity feed and a note field for the agent. Source: app replica on https://doop.design/ and https://doop.design/docs; the app itself (/c/...) needs a login.
3. `3-stage` — screen alone on a stage, all tools in a command palette.
4. `4-dock` — one rounded tool dock, one sheet at a time, pin to keep open; variants as chips, comments as pins.
5. `5-review` — Review changes mode: changed region outlined, list of agent writes, timeline.

**UX Design recommendation:** 4 as the base. From 2 take the live agent status pill and the Activity tab; the palette from 3 as a keyboard layer; 5 as a later mode. Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.

### Decision and refinement (2026-11-26)

Christian chose **Stitch** (1-stitch). Dock, Doop, Stage and Review are not pursued for now. Refined in mockup `ui-refresh-stitch` (variants `base`, `mockups-tab`; PNGs in `mockups/ui-refresh-stitch/renders/`):
- The canvas shows exactly one screen, the open one (110%, about 970 x 620 px at 1440 x 900).
- One left card with a segmented control **Screens | Mockups** (counts in the segments, find field below); the separate Mockups card is gone.
- A floating **vertical tool bar** between the card and the screen, top-aligned with the frame: Comment, Variants (count badge), Inspect, Preview, separator, More. Icons with short labels; `role="toolbar"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, tooltips open to the right.
- The toolbar above the frame is removed.
- Unchanged from 1-stitch: floating top groups (brand + project, views, Live + Follow agent + settings), right icon rail (notes, comments with badge, flow, design system), zoom pill at the bottom.
Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.
